sentences.text:
Rizwan Ahmad(Qureshi), Zulfikar Ali Counsel for Opposite Party(s) :
G.A., Manish Mishra, Surendra Prasad Mishra HON'BLE VIKAS BUDHWAR, J. 1.

Heard Sri Rizwan Ahmad, learned counsel for the applicants, Sri S.P. Singh, learned A.G.A. for the State and Sri S.P. Mishra for the O.P. No.2.
2.

This is an application u/s 528 of BNSS preferred by the applicants for quashing the entire proceedings of Complaint Case No.2287/2021, Smt. Rubina vs.Aasim & others, under Sections 498A, 323, 504, 506 I.P.C. & Section 3/4 Dowry Prohibition Act, Police Station Bachhraon, District Amroha, pending in the Court of I-Additional Civil Judge (Senior Division)/Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Amroha and also to quash the impugned summoning order dated 23.12.2021 passed by the learned I-Additional Civil Judge (Senior Division)/Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Amroha.

sentences.text: 3. Learned counsel for the applicants has invited the attention of the Court towards the supplementary affidavit dated 29.08.2025 (Annexure-SA1, at page-8 onward) so as to contend that the parties have entered into a compromise on 18.08.2025 in the Case no.2287 of 2021 (Now new number "1486 of 2023") under Sections 498-A, 323, 504, 506 IPC read with Section 3/4 of D.P. Act.

Learned counsel for the applicants submits that the said compromise has been filed before the court below, a direction be issued to verify the same and till verification is done, protection be accorded.
4.

Learned A.G.A. as well as counsel for O.P. No.2 submits that as per the certified copy so annexed herewith, it appears that a compromise has been entered between the parties and thus, a direction be issued to the court below for verifying the same.

5. Considering the submissions so made across the Bar, the application stands disposed of requiring the applicants (parties) to appear before the court of I-Additional Civil Judge (Senior Division)/Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Amroha along with the self-attested copy of the supplementary affidavit and application under Section 528 of BNSS, certified copy of the order by 26.09.2025, and on the said motion, the court below shall proceed to verify the compromise with most expedition.

entities.text: I-Additional Civil Judge (Senior Division)/Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Amroha
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: A date be fixed by the court below, on which date, parties may be directed to appear for verifying the compromise.

6. Till the verification proceeding is completed, no coercive action shall be taken against the applicants with respect to Complaint Case No.2287/2021, Smt.
